novel_features.name: Topic dossier
novel_features.description: Pull every highlight and saved-document passage you have on a topic into one source-attributed, note-ready result.
novel_features.rationale: Needs one offline full-text query across highlights, books and Reader documents joined back to their sources, which no single API call or rate-limited live search can do.
novel_features.example: readwise-pp-cli ask "attention is all you need" --include highlights,docs --group-by source --format md
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before writing or deciding on a topic, when an agent needs everything the user already read about it in one bounded response.

novel_features.name: Reading backlog and time-budget triage
novel_features.description: See your whole reading debt by location, estimated minutes and age, and pick what fits the time you have.
novel_features.rationale: Packs unread documents by word count, reading time and age from the local store, which the throttled list endpoint cannot answer quickly or repeatably.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the user has a fixed reading slot and wants a deterministic plan instead of scrolling the Reader inbox.

novel_features.name: Cross-corpus duplicate detection
novel_features.description: Find the same article saved twice, or saved both as a Reader document and as a classic Readwise source.
novel_features.rationale: Requires normalizing URLs and title/author keys across Reader documents and classic books together in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before bulk exports or cleanups; the command is read-only and never deletes, so pass the IDs you choose to documents bulk-update --dry-run first.

novel_features.name: Cross-source highlight digest
novel_features.description: Roll up everything you highlighted in a time window across your Readwise books, articles, tweets and podcasts, grouped by source.
novel_features.rationale: Groups the synced Readwise highlights updated in a window by source and category, which the all-or-nothing export cannot do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for a weekly review or to file a period's highlights into a notes system.

novel_features.name: Stale and orphan finder
novel_features.description: Surface forgotten, never-opened saved documents (as Reader IDs you can pass to documents bulk-update) and books with zero highlights.
novel_features.rationale: Selects by reading progress, last-opened age and zero-highlight sources across the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to find cleanup candidates; the command is read-only, and only the document IDs (not the zero-highlight books) can be archived with documents bulk-update.

novel_features.name: What-to-read-next ranker
novel_features.description: Get a short ranked shortlist of unread Reader documents that fit the minutes you have, favouring your preferred location and skipping ones you already started.
novel_features.rationale: Scores unread documents locally by time fit, recency and location preference, so the shortlist costs no API calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the user has a few minutes and asks what to read right now.

novel_features.name: Serendipity connections
novel_features.description: Find items you read months apart that share tags, authors or distinctive terms, from one seed item or across the library.
novel_features.rationale: Joins highlights, documents and books on shared tags, authors and stopword-filtered terms, which no API endpoint exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to resurface related past reading for a seed item without doing a topic search.

novel_features.name: Saved-query watches
novel_features.description: Save a query and see only the new matching documents and highlights since the last run.
novel_features.rationale: Keeps per-query seen state in a CLI-side table and evaluates it against the synced store, so repeat checks cost no extra API calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in scheduled agent jobs that must process only new items for standing topics.

novel_features.name: Signed webhook delivery
novel_features.description: Register https endpoints that receive new 'watch run --notify' matches, optionally HMAC-signed with a shared secret and SSRF-checked before delivery.
novel_features.rationale: Builds on the CLI-side watch state to deliver HMAC-SHA256-signed alerts, a feature Readwise does not offer for saved queries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to push watch alerts into another automation; add a watch first, then run 'watch run --notify'.

narrative.headline: Every Readwise and Reader feature, plus a local mirror of your whole library that you can search, triage and dedupe offline.
narrative.value_prop: Sync your highlights, books and Reader documents once into a local SQLite store, then query them without the 20-requests-a-minute list limit. Ask what you have already read on a topic with `ask`, plan a reading slot with `backlog` and `read-next`, and clean up with `dedupe` and `triage stale`. Writes (save, tag, archive, bulk update) still go straight to the API, with dry runs first.
narrative.auth_narrative: Readwise uses a personal access token from https://readwise.io/access_token, sent as `Authorization: Token <token>`. One token covers both the classic v2 API and the Reader v3 API. Set it in READWISE_API_TOKEN.

quickstart.comment: Checks config and the token without calling the network.
Builds the local mirror once; later syncs are incremental.
Offline full-text search over what you synced.
Plans a 30-minute reading slot from your unread queue.
Gathers everything you have on a topic, with sources.

troubleshoots.symptom: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests during sync or list commands
troubleshoots.fix: Wait for the Retry-After delay the CLI reports, then rerun `readwise-pp-cli sync`; use local commands instead of repeated live lists.

troubleshoots.symptom: Commands say the local store is empty or stale

troubleshoots.fix: Set a fresh token from https://readwise.io/access_token in READWISE_API_TOKEN, then run `readwise-pp-cli doctor`.

troubleshoots.symptom: Bulk update reports some items failed
troubleshoots.fix: The API returned a partial success; rerun `documents bulk-update` with only the failed IDs it listed.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs the user's own Readwise highlights, books or Reader documents: especially 'what have I read or highlighted about X', reading-backlog and what-to-read-next questions, weekly highlight digests, duplicate cleanup, or saving and tagging articles in Reader. It is the right tool when offline speed and unified search across both APIs matter, or when the 20-requests-a-minute list limits would otherwise throttle bulk reads; run sync first so the local commands have data. It also edits and deletes: highlights create/update/delete, books update, documents update/bulk-update/delete (delete cascades to the document's highlights and notes) and review complete; preview writes with --dry-run first.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to read or summarize the full text of the web article itself; it works with what the user saved and highlighted.
Do not use it to manage Readwise Books shelves, ratings or reading sessions, Reader ZIP exports, or video timestamp highlights; those APIs are not publicly documented and are not supported.
Do not use it to configure Readwise's own webhooks or integrations; those are set up in the Readwise web app.
Do not use it for semantic or vector search; search here is local full-text.
Do not use it to decide whether two sources agree or contradict each other; connections reports tag, author and term overlap only, not stance.

recipes.title: Topic dossier for a draft
recipes.explanation: Collects every highlight and passage on a topic into note-ready blocks with their sources.

recipes.title: Narrow a large document list for an agent
recipes.explanation: Returns only the fields an agent needs from a large Reader list.

recipes.title: Weekly highlight review
recipes.explanation: Rolls up the week's highlights across all sources for filing into notes.

recipes.title: Safe cleanup pass
recipes.explanation: Lists forgotten documents as IDs you can archive with documents bulk-update.

recipes.title: Alert on new reading about a topic
recipes.command: readwise-pp-cli watch add --name stoicism --kind highlights --query stoicism
recipes.explanation: Saves a highlights query; after each sync, 'watch run --notify' shows (or pushes to a registered webhook) only the new matches.
